_comment: `@__NO_SIDE_EFFECTS__` should apply to a function exported after its declaration (`export { fn }`, `export { fn as alias }`, `export { fn as default }`, `export default fn`), as it does for `export function fn`. Two entries put the annotated modules in a shared chunk, so the per-chunk minifier cannot remove the calls and the result depends on tree-shaking alone. Every call in entry-a.js except the last two should be eliminated.
